ecosystem_cases.what_is_observed: A public institutional introduction describes a talent-company-community innovation ecology.
ecosystem_cases.relevant_mechanism: Make the operating relationship among learning, enterprise exchange and public-facing activity explicit.
ecosystem_cases.not_transferable: No local partnership, carrier, programme, investment or approval follows from the reference.
ecosystem_cases.jingzhang_conceptual_test: Test a human-stewarded referral route between ordinary learning, supervised validation and public explanation.

ecosystem_cases.what_is_observed: The official account describes accountable research-to-industry translation.
ecosystem_cases.relevant_mechanism: Separate research activity from adoption claims through traceable review and handover.
ecosystem_cases.not_transferable: It is not evidence of a Jing-Zhang institution, talent supply, funding or corporate participation.
ecosystem_cases.jingzhang_conceptual_test: Use S07 as a staffed evidence-and-appeal interface before any independent adoption decision.

ecosystem_cases.what_is_observed: The public description presents research, exchange and open-science-oriented communication.
ecosystem_cases.relevant_mechanism: Give public explanation and consent a distinct operating surface rather than treating outreach as marketing.
ecosystem_cases.not_transferable: No affiliation, model access, programme or event is implied locally.
ecosystem_cases.jingzhang_conceptual_test: Use S05 for moderated model-literacy sessions whose content expires with its evidence status.

ecosystem_cases.what_is_observed: Public platform documentation describes service and governance boundaries for a shared AI platform.
ecosystem_cases.relevant_mechanism: Document service boundaries, human escalation and version status before a capability is offered.
ecosystem_cases.not_transferable: No local compute, data, cybersecurity posture, service commitment or government arrangement is inferred.
ecosystem_cases.jingzhang_conceptual_test: S12 makes source/version review a public precondition; absent provenance returns the task to NO-BUILD.

ecosystem_cases.what_is_observed: The programme description shows a testbed-demonstrator-adoption pathway.
ecosystem_cases.relevant_mechanism: Use a staged pathway that can stop after a test rather than assuming scaling.
ecosystem_cases.not_transferable: No local procurement, operator, approval, funding or performance outcome follows.
ecosystem_cases.jingzhang_conceptual_test: S01/S04/S07 are three independently resettable concept tests, not a delivery portfolio.

scenario_cards.title: Embodied AI physical validation
scenario_cards.current_ordinary_baseline: Planning, code review and simulation use ordinary rooms.
scenario_cards.ai_capability: Bounded physical model and equipment observation.
scenario_cards.user_need: A qualified team needs to observe a real physical task without transferring risk to the public realm.
scenario_cards.why_insufficient: A real, supervised physical test requires a controllable safety and reset edge that simulation alone cannot provide.
scenario_cards.admission_trigger: Verified task, carrier rights, qualified operator, safety envelope, public-route continuity and a reset rehearsal.
scenario_cards.minimum_spatial_delta: Removable boundary rail, observation edge and plug-in test kit inside a verified carrier; no building claim.
scenario_cards.operation: Time-bounded supervised session; no unsupervised public operation.
scenario_cards.human_authority: Qualified operator may propose; verified carrier steward may operate; qualified safety lead may stop.
scenario_cards.privacy_risk: Minimum authorized records only; no facial recognition, public surveillance or unapproved personal data.
scenario_cards.failure_mode: Unsafe state, stale authorization or public-route conflict.
scenario_cards.stop_reset: Emergency stop, remove kit and return to ordinary training/work use.
scenario_cards.evidence_status: CONCEPT_PROPOSAL; authorization, survey and professional safety confirmation required.
scenario_cards.site_area_relation: Zhongzhiyuan typological north carrier; not an identified parcel or facility.

scenario_cards.title: Environmental robustness rehearsal
scenario_cards.current_ordinary_baseline: Software-in-the-loop rehearsal and manual field inspection.
scenario_cards.ai_capability: Compare a bounded model output with a staff-verified condition.
scenario_cards.user_need: Developers and maintainers need to detect a mismatch before a public-facing claim is made.
scenario_cards.minimum_spatial_delta: NO-BUILD; existing work session and manual inspection suffice.
scenario_cards.operation: Scheduled desktop rehearsal followed by optional human inspection.
scenario_cards.human_authority: Qualified reviewer accepts or rejects the comparison.
scenario_cards.privacy_risk: Use non-personal, minimized task records only.
scenario_cards.failure_mode: Unverified carrier, environmental harm or a public disturbance.
scenario_cards.stop_reset: Withdraw the output and keep ordinary maintenance practice.
scenario_cards.site_area_relation: Zhongzhiyuan typological north area; no street occupancy is proposed.

scenario_cards.title: Human safety and evidence review
scenario_cards.current_ordinary_baseline: Professional desktop audit in an ordinary meeting room.
scenario_cards.ai_capability: Organize an evidence bundle for human review; it does not decide.
scenario_cards.user_need: A reviewer needs a traceable way to reject unsupported claims.
scenario_cards.minimum_spatial_delta: NO-BUILD; ordinary room and archival practice suffice.
scenario_cards.operation: Versioned review meeting with a human sign-off or rejection.
scenario_cards.human_authority: Independent qualified reviewer can stop or return the claim.
scenario_cards.privacy_risk: No private operational or personal data enters the bundle.
scenario_cards.stop_reset: Archive or delete the unsupported bundle and restore ordinary meeting use.
scenario_cards.evidence_status: DESIGN_RULE; not a statutory approval process.
scenario_cards.site_area_relation: North-area operational support only; no site intervention.

scenario_cards.title: Multi-modal collaboration handover
scenario_cards.current_ordinary_baseline: Most learning and teamwork use ordinary rooms.
scenario_cards.ai_capability: A controlled, time-limited multi-modal collaboration session.
scenario_cards.user_need: Participants need a visible handover between public learning and a consent-bound project session.
scenario_cards.why_insufficient: An ordinary study room cannot distinguish an authorized, acoustically bounded handover from open public study without eroding the public floor.
scenario_cards.admission_trigger: Verified public-side carrier, opening agreement, project/data boundary, accessibility check, named steward and reset rehearsal.
scenario_cards.minimum_spatial_delta: Reversible acoustic screen, session-status marker and removable materials; no permanent room claim.
scenario_cards.operation: Booked and stewarded session, returning to ordinary learning between sessions.
scenario_cards.human_authority: Carrier steward may operate; accessibility representative may contest; safety lead may stop.
scenario_cards.privacy_risk: Data-minimized, consent-bound materials; no ambient collection in public learning space.
scenario_cards.failure_mode: Route blockage, expired consent, absent steward or accessibility conflict.
scenario_cards.stop_reset: Clear materials, retract screen and restore an ordinary public room.
scenario_cards.evidence_status: CONCEPT_PROPOSAL; access, carrier and professional review required.
scenario_cards.site_area_relation: AI Origin typological middle public-side threshold; not a campus access claim.

scenario_cards.title: Open AI literacy and model explanation
scenario_cards.current_ordinary_baseline: Community activity room, printed material and a facilitator.
scenario_cards.ai_capability: A moderated explanation or demonstration of a clearly bounded model claim.
scenario_cards.user_need: People need to understand the purpose, limit and appeal route before an AI service is discussed.
scenario_cards.minimum_spatial_delta: NO-BUILD; portable teaching kit in an ordinary activity room.
scenario_cards.human_authority: Facilitator pauses the session and removes unsupported material.
scenario_cards.privacy_risk: No attendance profiling; no required account or biometric collection.
scenario_cards.failure_mode: Unmoderated claim, inaccessible format or stale evidence.
scenario_cards.stop_reset: End session, remove material and keep the ordinary room available.
scenario_cards.evidence_status: CONCEPT_PROPOSAL; event, host and venue are not committed.
scenario_cards.site_area_relation: AI Origin public-side ordinary room typology.

scenario_cards.title: Community service co-pilot with human counter
scenario_cards.current_ordinary_baseline: Staffed walk-in service counter and paper guide.
scenario_cards.ai_capability: Optional staff-facing summarization and referral support.
scenario_cards.user_need: Residents need understandable access to a human service without digital exclusion.
scenario_cards.minimum_spatial_delta: NO-BUILD; retain ordinary counter and visible paper alternative.
scenario_cards.operation: Staff chooses whether to use a bounded assistive tool; no automatic decision.
scenario_cards.human_authority: Service worker decides, corrects and stops use; resident may insist on human-only service.
scenario_cards.privacy_risk: No data use without lawful basis; sensitive case material stays out of demonstration content.
scenario_cards.failure_mode: Bias, exclusion, offline state or loss of walk-in service.
scenario_cards.stop_reset: Immediate human-only counter and paper process.
scenario_cards.evidence_status: CONCEPT_PROPOSAL; no government-service deployment is claimed.
scenario_cards.site_area_relation: Ordinary community-service typology; no specific service site is asserted.

scenario_cards.title: Staffed adoption and compliance review
scenario_cards.current_ordinary_baseline: General business, legal or public-service referral uses an ordinary desk.
scenario_cards.ai_capability: A timed evidence, appeal and review workflow for a proposed AI use.
scenario_cards.user_need: Affected users and small operators need a contestable, human-visible route before an adoption claim is considered.
scenario_cards.why_insufficient: A standard desk does not safely expose queue privacy, appeal, evidence versioning and a staffed review side at the same time.
scenario_cards.admission_trigger: Verified carrier, privacy route, named reviewer, appeal path, paper fallback, operator agreement and rehearsal.
scenario_cards.minimum_spatial_delta: Removable privacy screen, staffed appeal desk and visible evidence-status board; no station or retail alteration claim.
scenario_cards.operation: Staffed review session only; it may refer or reject but never automatically approve.
scenario_cards.human_authority: Qualified reviewer may stop; affected user may contest; carrier steward controls opening.
scenario_cards.privacy_risk: Minimum case record, no public display of personal data, deletion/archival rule before reset.
scenario_cards.failure_mode: Stale evidence, absent reviewer, privacy breach or lost paper fallback.
scenario_cards.stop_reset: Stop intake, use ordinary referral desk, remove screen and archive/delete per the agreed rule.
scenario_cards.evidence_status: CONCEPT_PROPOSAL; authorization, access and professional confirmation required.
scenario_cards.site_area_relation: Dazhongsi typological station-city service interface; not a metro-zone or commercial-tenancy claim.

scenario_cards.title: Step-free wayfinding assistance
scenario_cards.current_ordinary_baseline: Tactile guidance, fixed signage, staff assistance and an accessible route audit.
scenario_cards.ai_capability: Optional status explanation after the route is independently verified.
scenario_cards.user_need: A traveler needs reliable, non-digital guidance even when live information fails.
scenario_cards.minimum_spatial_delta: NO-BUILD; physical guidance and staff remain primary.
scenario_cards.operation: Facility/operator status is checked before any optional message is displayed.
scenario_cards.human_authority: Duty officer withdraws a message when route status is unknown.
scenario_cards.privacy_risk: No location tracking or individualized routing is needed.
scenario_cards.failure_mode: Unverified route, inaccessible detour or stale status.
scenario_cards.stop_reset: Withdraw message; retain physical signs and human escort.
scenario_cards.site_area_relation: Dazhongsi continuity concept, subject to access and operator confirmation.

scenario_cards.title: Post-rain greenway maintenance check
scenario_cards.current_ordinary_baseline: Manual inspection, maintenance work order and temporary safety marking.
scenario_cards.ai_capability: Optional prioritization cue after a staff field observation.
scenario_cards.user_need: Park users need a safe, maintained path without passive surveillance.
scenario_cards.minimum_spatial_delta: NO-BUILD; ordinary maintenance operation and removable safety marker.
scenario_cards.operation: Staff confirms condition on site before action.
scenario_cards.human_authority: Maintenance lead accepts, corrects or rejects a cue.
scenario_cards.privacy_risk: No person monitoring; use condition records only.
scenario_cards.failure_mode: Alert without field confirmation, ecological harm or blocked maintenance route.
scenario_cards.stop_reset: Remove temporary marker after inspection and retain manual work order.
scenario_cards.evidence_status: CONCEPT_PROPOSAL; ecology and access survey required.
scenario_cards.site_area_relation: Jing-Zhang heritage-park public-space response, no surveyed ecological claim.

scenario_cards.title: Facility status relay with analog fallback
scenario_cards.current_ordinary_baseline: Fixed decision-point signs and a physically legible alternative route.
scenario_cards.ai_capability: Optional short-lived explanation of a verified facility status.
scenario_cards.user_need: People need a clear choice without assuming phone access.
scenario_cards.minimum_spatial_delta: NO-BUILD; retain physical indication as the primary service.
scenario_cards.operation: Publish only a timestamped, operator-confirmed status.
scenario_cards.stop_reset: Withdraw digital message while physical signs persist.
scenario_cards.site_area_relation: Overall public-route typology; no facility ownership asserted.

scenario_cards.title: Community event quiet-boundary stewardship
scenario_cards.current_ordinary_baseline: Human event steward, portable acoustic baffle and ordinary plaza rule.
scenario_cards.ai_capability: Optional non-identifying operational prompt for a steward.
scenario_cards.user_need: Residents and visitors need cultural activity without loss of quiet, access or refuge.
scenario_cards.minimum_spatial_delta: NO-BUILD; removable event kit and ordinary public space suffice.
scenario_cards.operation: Human steward manages time, sound and exit.
scenario_cards.human_authority: Safety lead stops the event at a confirmed threshold.
scenario_cards.privacy_risk: No crowd profiling or biometric counting.
scenario_cards.failure_mode: Noise, light, access or refuge threshold conflict.
scenario_cards.stop_reset: Stop activity, remove kit and restore open plaza.
scenario_cards.evidence_status: CONCEPT_PROPOSAL; no annual event or venue commitment.

scenario_cards.title: Evidence-status change review
scenario_cards.current_ordinary_baseline: Professional planner checks source, version and assumption register.
scenario_cards.ai_capability: Optional change detection that only proposes a review queue.
scenario_cards.user_need: A team needs to know when a design assertion must pause rather than silently persist.
scenario_cards.minimum_spatial_delta: NO-BUILD; ordinary archival and review practice suffice.
scenario_cards.operation: Versioned human review and public correction where relevant.
scenario_cards.human_authority: Principal reviewer pauses any affected claim.
scenario_cards.privacy_risk: Use public or cleared source metadata only.
scenario_cards.failure_mode: Missing provenance, source conflict or unreviewed change.
scenario_cards.stop_reset: Pause the affected proposal claim until official or professional confirmation.
scenario_cards.evidence_status: DESIGN_RULE; does not create statutory authority.
scenario_cards.site_area_relation: Whole-of-package evidence operation; no physical intervention.

validation_scenarios.test_objective: Confirm whether a removable safety edge can contain a real physical task without reducing ordinary access.
validation_scenarios.admission_condition: Task, rights, qualified operator, safety plan, carrier, public-route continuity and reset rehearsal all confirmed.
validation_scenarios.physical_or_operational_interface: Removable rail, observation edge, plug-in kit and physical emergency stop.
validation_scenarios.measurable_validation_criterion: A rehearsal records zero uncontrolled-route conflict, a working human stop, and a completed reset before any further professional decision.
validation_scenarios.human_authority: Qualified safety lead stops; independent reviewer rejects insufficient evidence.
validation_scenarios.privacy_safety_boundary: No facial recognition, public surveillance or unapproved personal data.
validation_scenarios.failure_state: Unsafe state, stale authorization or route conflict.
validation_scenarios.reset_fallback: Remove kit and return to ordinary training/work.
validation_scenarios.next_professional_deepening_dependency: Carrier rights, fire/life-safety, structural, power and operational review.

validation_scenarios.test_objective: Confirm that a consent-bound handover can coexist with open learning without converting a public room into a closed project enclave.
validation_scenarios.admission_condition: Opening agreement, data boundary, accessibility review, steward, carrier and reset rehearsal confirmed.
validation_scenarios.physical_or_operational_interface: Reversible acoustic screen, visible session-status marker and removable materials.
validation_scenarios.measurable_validation_criterion: A rehearsal records continuous accessible public passage, a visible human handover, cleared materials and an ordinary-room reset.
validation_scenarios.human_authority: Carrier steward operates; accessibility representative contests; safety lead stops.
validation_scenarios.privacy_safety_boundary: Consent-bound materials only; no ambient collection in public learning space.
validation_scenarios.failure_state: Route blockage, expired consent, absent steward or accessibility conflict.
validation_scenarios.reset_fallback: Retract screen, clear materials and restore ordinary public learning.
validation_scenarios.next_professional_deepening_dependency: Access agreement, acoustic/fire review, accessibility review and data governance confirmation.

validation_scenarios.test_objective: Confirm that an affected user can see, contest and leave an AI adoption review without losing ordinary service.
validation_scenarios.admission_condition: Carrier, privacy route, named reviewer, appeal path, paper fallback and rehearsal confirmed.
validation_scenarios.physical_or_operational_interface: Removable privacy screen, staffed appeal desk and evidence-status board.
validation_scenarios.measurable_validation_criterion: A rehearsal records human-only intake, an accessible appeal path, a successful evidence correction and reset to ordinary referral.
validation_scenarios.human_authority: Qualified reviewer stops; affected user contests; carrier steward controls opening.
validation_scenarios.privacy_safety_boundary: Minimum case records, no public personal-data display, deletion or archival rule before reset.
validation_scenarios.failure_state: Stale evidence, absent reviewer, privacy breach or lost paper fallback.
validation_scenarios.reset_fallback: Stop intake, retain ordinary referral and remove screen.
validation_scenarios.next_professional_deepening_dependency: Owner/operator agreement, legal/privacy review, accessibility review and service-process confirmation.

landmarks.site_role: Zhongzhiyuan carrier-edge threshold for S01 evidence and reset.
landmarks.public_experience: A passer-by reads what is ordinary, what is temporarily tested and when the state returns to ordinary city.
landmarks.ai_behavior: Shows session status and reset receipt only; it collects no public biometric or location data.
landmarks.cultural_relation: A railway seam is read as a handover and return, not as retro decoration.
landmarks.reversibility: remove with the session kit; no permanent structural claim
landmarks.operational_steward_concept: verified carrier steward and safety lead
landmarks.evidence_assumption_status: CONCEPT_PROPOSAL; carrier, rights and safety conditions UNKNOWN

landmarks.site_role: AI Origin public-side threshold for S04 consent and public-learning handover.
landmarks.public_experience: Visitors can read the session boundary, ask for human explanation and use the table normally when AI is off.
landmarks.ai_behavior: Displays a human-signed session state; it does not infer consent or profile visitors.
landmarks.cultural_relation: Makes Zhongguancun's exchange culture legible as a contestable public handover.
landmarks.physical_intervention_class: ordinary table with removable status layer
landmarks.reversibility: clear materials and return to ordinary public learning
landmarks.operational_steward_concept: public-side carrier steward and accessibility representative
landmarks.evidence_assumption_status: CONCEPT_PROPOSAL; access and opening agreement PAUSE_UNTIL_OFFICIAL_DATA

landmarks.site_role: Dazhongsi service interface for S07 human review and appeal.
landmarks.public_experience: An affected person finds a staffed human desk, paper alternative and clear appeal route before any AI adoption is discussed.
landmarks.ai_behavior: Shows evidence status and routes a request to a human reviewer; it cannot approve or rank people.
landmarks.cultural_relation: Participant conceptual translation: reads a crossing as a civic promise that every exceptional state has a visible way back.
landmarks.physical_intervention_class: staffed ordinary desk with removable privacy screen
landmarks.reversibility: remove screen and retain ordinary referral desk
landmarks.operational_steward_concept: verified service carrier steward and qualified reviewer
landmarks.evidence_assumption_status: CONCEPT_PROPOSAL; station/commercial access, authority and privacy process UNKNOWN

public_space_and_culture.heritage_park_response: Jing-Zhang Heritage Park is treated as a public reading-and-maintenance sequence: physical interpretation, rain-safe pause, human maintenance feedback and no surveillance-dependent experience.
public_space_and_culture.east_west_stitch: A surface walking stitch is the concept priority; no bridge, tunnel or parcel intervention is inferred.
public_space_and_culture.north_south_continuity: A station-ground-public-space sequence is audited for human-readable continuity before any specialist interface is considered.
public_space_and_culture.dazhongsi_everyday_economy: S07 protects ordinary small-business and civic referral continuity; it does not assert tenant change, commercial attraction, rent, metro access or a new consumption development.
public_space_and_culture.honor_display_system: Reversible Evidence Honor Rail displays public-interest contribution, consenting contributors, reviewed method, source, expiry and reset state. It excludes biometric ranking, unverified achievements and permanent celebrity branding.
cultural_storyline: Jing-Zhang railway resilience becomes a rule to earn exceptional states.
Surface continuity comes before specialist infrastructure.
Zhongguancun AI culture is a testable, contestable and resettable public process.
public_space_and_culture.signage_rule: Place + STATUS + allowed ACTION + human help + stop/reset; bilingual signs share one evidence status.
public_space_and_culture.international_narrative: An ordinary city that earns every exceptional state - and can give it back.

annual_sequence: Developer rehearsal in ordinary carriers or NO-BUILD
S01/S04/S07 supervised sessions only after admission
Public evidence week, independent review, archive or expiry and full reset
operation_cycle.developer_community_operation: A task is submitted, screened for public interest and ordinary-space sufficiency, rehearsed with a human steward, then either remains ordinary/NO-BUILD or enters a separately admitted supervised session.
operation_cycle.scenario_opening_rule: No opening before evidence gate, human authority, appeal route, access confirmation and reset rehearsal.
operation_cycle.public_landmark_operation: Landmarks and honor display expire or are removed when their evidence, consent or steward condition expires.
operation_cycle.international_communication: Publish the method, limit, human sign-off and reset result rather than a performance claim.
operation_cycle.funding_boundary: Options require future authorized budget and operating agreements; none are committed funding.
